name: Gym Class Pass Manager
author: Asdesign Web Studio

sections.description:
The simplest way to let your members book classes from their phone.

🏆 Gym Class Pass Manager was chosen by WordPress as a featured plugin in November 2026.

Gym Class Pass Manager turns your WordPress site into a clean, modern booking app for gyms, boxes and studios. Members open it on their phone, see the weekly schedule and book or cancel their spot in seconds. You manage everything from the same app — no extra software, no complicated setup.

Perfect if you just need reservations to work, without plans, payments or unnecessary features.

What your members get

  • A beautiful mobile web app that works on any phone or computer. Nothing to install.
  • The weekly schedule with colours, times and free spots at a glance.
  • One-tap booking and easy cancellation before the class starts.
  • Their own language in the app (the plugin is translated into multiple languages).

What you get as the centre

  • Activities — Yoga, Spinning, CrossFit, Pilates… each with its colour.
  • Weekly schedule — classes that repeat every week, with their own capacity and duration.
  • Capacity limit and waiting list — set how many spots each class has. When full, members join the waiting list and get in automatically if someone cancels.
  • Members — invite them by email. They create their password and start booking. Remove access anytime.
  • Trial class — when you invite someone, you can let them book a single trial class. Give them full access when they sign up. You can turn this option off in Settings → Centre.
  • Who is coming — see the list of people booked in each class.
  • Attendance — mark who showed up.
  • Cancel a class — cancel a single session and notify the members who booked.
  • No limits — unlimited members, activities, classes and bookings.

How it works

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Open the app from your WordPress dashboard and set your centre name and logo.
  3. Create your activities and build the weekly schedule.
  4. Invite your members and share the app address (for example yoursite.com/app/).
  5. They book from their phone. You see who is coming.

Everything is managed from the mobile app. WordPress is only used for the initial setup and a few options.

Gym Class Pass Manager Pro: run your whole centre from one app

Your members already book with your app. Now get paid from it too. Gym Class Pass Manager Pro turns the free booking app into the complete system for your gym, box or studio: fees collected automatically, classes that fill themselves and members who keep coming back.

Launch offer: 49€ instead of 149€. One single payment: no monthly fees, no subscription, no commissions.

  • Buy Gym Class Pass Manager Pro for 49€ →
  • Try the Pro version now

14-day money-back guarantee. Try it in your centre: if it is not for you, we refund your money.

Stop chasing payments

  • Plans and passes — monthly fees, class packs and drop-ins. Each member books only what their plan includes.
  • Online payments — card and Bizum with Redsys, Stripe, PayPal or your WooCommerce shop. No commissions from us.
  • Automatic renewals — plans renew and charge themselves every month. Payments at reception are recorded too.
  • Reports — revenue and bookings month by month, by activity and payment method.

Full classes, empty no-shows

  • Smart waiting list — when someone cancels, the next member gets the spot and a notice automatically.
  • Cancellation rules — deadline to cancel for free and penalties for repeated no-shows.
  • Notifications — email, SMS, WhatsApp and push: confirmations, reminders, cancellations and announcements.
  • Calendar sync and Zoom classes — classes in Google, Apple or Outlook calendar, and online sessions with one tap.

Members who stay

  • Community — a social feed for your centre with photos, reactions and comments.
  • Workout of the day and leaderboards — publish the WOD, link it to a class and members log their result at Rx, Scaled or Beginner.
  • Personal records, challenges and achievements — every member sees their progress.
  • Routines with timers — stopwatch, EMOM, Tabata and intervals, with an exercise library of over 300 exercises.

The whole centre under control

  • Coaches with permissions — they take attendance and publish workouts; you decide what else they can do.
  • Several locations — more than one centre from the same app.
  • QR access control — members check in at the door with a changing QR code.
  • Your own Android and iOS app — your name and icon on Google Play and the App Store.
  • Fully translated into English, Spanish and German, with direct support in your language.

Move to Pro in 2 minutes, without losing anything

Buy it, upload it in Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin and activate it. Your activities, schedule, members and bookings stay exactly where they are: no migration, no setup from scratch.

  • Buy Gym Class Pass Manager Pro for 49€ → One-time payment · 1 website · 14-day money-back guarantee.
  • Try the Pro version →

External services

This plugin does not connect to any external service.

Source code

The JavaScript and CSS files distributed with this plugin (in the assets/ folder) are the human-readable source. They are not minified or compiled from another private repository. No build tools are required to review or modify them.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Gym Class Pass Manager from Plugins → Add New.
  2. Go to Gym Class Pass Manager → Start and press “Open the app”. Log in with your WordPress user.
  3. In the app, create your activities (Settings → Activities) and your weekly schedule (Settings → Weekly schedule).
  4. Invite your members from Members. Give them the app address so they can save it on their phone.
sections.faq:
Can members book any class?

Yes. Anyone with an account at the centre can book any class while there are spots left, and cancel it until it starts. The only exception is members invited with a trial class: they can book one class until you give them full access.

How does the trial class work?

When you invite someone from Members → Invite, tick “Trial class”. That person can book one class only (booked, attended or on the waiting list). If they cancel it before it starts, they can choose another one. Managers get an email when a trial member books their class. When they sign up, open their profile in Members and press “Give full access”. To stop offering trial classes, turn off “Trial class in invitations” in Settings → Centre; members already on a trial keep it until you give them full access.

The app shows “page not found”

Go to Settings → Permalinks and press “Save Changes”. If you use a cache plugin, exclude the app address.

Invitation emails do not arrive

Gym Class Pass Manager uses the normal WordPress email. If emails end up in spam or are not sent, install an SMTP plugin with an email account on your domain.

Is my data deleted if I remove the plugin?

No, unless you tick “Also delete activities, schedule and bookings” in Gym Class Pass Manager → Start before deleting it. User accounts are never deleted.

How much does Gym Class Pass Manager Pro cost?

49€ with the launch offer (regular price 149€). It is one single payment for one website: no monthly fees, no subscription and no commissions on your members’ payments. It includes updates from your WordPress dashboard and direct support in English, Spanish and German. Buy it here.

Can I try Gym Class Pass Manager Pro before buying it?

Yes. Open the live demo: it opens full screen in your browser, with sample data, so you can try payments, plans, notifications, workouts and the community as your manager and your members would see them. Nothing to install.

What if Gym Class Pass Manager Pro is not for me?

You have a 14-day money-back guarantee. If it does not convince you, write to us within 14 days of your purchase and we refund your money.

Where do I get Gym Class Pass Manager Pro?

Only at gymclass.estudio-web.es. It is a separate plugin: buy it there, then upload and activate it from Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.

What happens if I move to Gym Class Pass Manager Pro?

When you activate Gym Class Pass Manager Pro, this free version steps aside and Pro keeps your activities, schedule, members and bookings. You can then delete the free plugin.
sections.changelog:
5.0

  • Manager panel: your centre’s figures (members booking and bookings in the next 7 days) with the «Buy Pro» and «Try Pro version» buttons.
  • «Try Pro version» opens the live demo of Gym Class Pass Manager Pro full screen. «Buy Pro» goes straight to checkout.
  • Tips about Gym Class Pass Manager Pro where they are useful (who is coming to a class, a member’s profile, full classes). Only the manager sees them and each one can be closed for 30 days. Members never see them.
  • A line next to the buy buttons: one-time payment, and you keep all your data when you move to Pro.
  • Review request on WordPress.org after one week and 50 bookings, with «Later» and «I already did».
  • 14-day money-back guarantee shown next to every «Buy Pro» button.
  • A one-off message for the manager when the centre reaches 100, 250, 500, 1,000… bookings. It can be closed.
  • Welcome screen: a short line about Gym Class Pass Manager Pro with the «Try Pro version» link.
  • Space Grotesk typography across the whole plugin.
  • The Pro version is always called by its full name, Gym Class Pass Manager Pro.
  • New box on the Start and Gym Class Pass Manager Pro pages: featured plugin on WordPress during its launch.
  • Manager panel, Pro box: it also mentions that with Pro each member only books the activities of their paid plan.
  • Updated translations (Spanish and German).

4.2

  • Gym Class Pass Manager Pro page: two buttons, «Buy Pro» (goes straight to checkout) and «See Gym Class Pass Manager Pro» (goes to the website).

4.1

  • New: complete German translation of the app and the WordPress pages (Germany, Austria and Switzerland, informal and formal).
  • The login screen shows the centre logo above the site name, aligned to the left.
  • Manager panel: the shortcuts no longer leave a box alone on its row; the panel looks the same as in Gym Class Pass Manager Pro.
  • Same design as Gym Class Pass Manager Pro: white boxes for the Gym Class Pass Manager Pro information and the live demo banner.
  • Gym Class Pass Manager Pro information: fully translated into English, Spanish and German, with support in those languages.
  • Gym Class Pass Manager Pro launch offer: 49€ (was 149€), in a box with the same dark background as «Bookings today» and the button «Get Gym Class Pass Manager Pro».
  • The Gym Class Pass Manager Pro box in the manager panel and in Settings has the same dark background as the «Bookings today» box.
  • The Free and Pro comparison now shows the waiting list as included in the free version.

4.0

  • Members can log in with their email or with the phone number saved in their account.
  • The panel greets each person by their name (the email is shown only until the name is filled in).
  • The login screen no longer scrolls when there is nothing below the form.

3.5

  • No coloured left borders on any box (notices, schedule, booking cards, workouts, menus).

3.1

  • New design: clean white interface, Plus Jakarta Sans typography, classes shown as a list with an icon per activity, flat bottom bar and a redesigned manager panel.
  • The plugin pages in WordPress use the same design.

3.0

  • Gym Class Pass Manager Pro launch offer: 49€ (was 149€).

2.5.1

  • New: get an email when someone books their trial class, so you know who is coming to try your centre.
  • Trial members are now marked in each class’s attendee list, so your team can welcome them.
  • After their trial class, members who still need full access are highlighted so nobody slips through.
  • Small visual improvements in member lists.

2.5

  • New: trial classes. When you invite someone, you can let them book one class to try your centre.
  • Trial members see how their trial is going right in the schedule.
  • If they cancel their trial class in time, they can pick another one.
  • Give a trial member full access with one tap from their profile.
  • You can turn trial classes off in the centre settings whenever you want.

2.1

  • Límite de aforo en cada clase.
  • Lista de espera automática: si la clase está llena, los socios se apuntan y entran solos cuando alguien cancela.
  • Las actividades solo piden nombre y color. Las plazas y la duración se configuran en cada clase del horario.

2.0

  • Nuevo panel del gestor con resumen del día y accesos directos.
  • Página de Gym Class Pass Manager Pro dentro de la app con comparación de funciones.
  • Mejoras en la pantalla de bienvenida y en la gestión diaria.

1.6

  • Pro tab removed from the bottom menu.
  • Panel bottom spacing fixed so content no longer jumps.
  • Manager panel with today’s KPIs, shortcuts and classes.
  • Pro page reachable from the panel banner.

1.5

  • Welcome screen columns balanced; steps in one column, usage guide wider.
  • Clearer explanation that day-to-day work happens in the mobile app.
  • Space Grotesk font in the welcome screen.

1.2

  • New professional plugin description.
  • Wider welcome screen with a usage guide and app link.

1.1.1

  • Redesigned welcome screen with cards and icons.

1.1.0

  • Mark attendance on each class (attended / not attended).
  • Member booking history and internal notes.
  • Cancel a single class with a reason and email the members who booked.
  • Export class attendance and members to CSV.
  • Simple email reminder the day before a class.
  • Today’s occupancy summary on the Start page.
  • Subscribe to the schedule with an iCal link.
  • Pro feature cards with a clear upgrade path.
  • Modern welcome screen on first install.
  • Security and polish improvements.

1.0.1

  • Renamed plugin to Gym Class Pass Manager.
  • Fixed script loading to use wp_add_inline_script instead of a raw script tag.
  • Added contributor asdesignes and documented source location for JS/CSS.

1.0.0

  • First version: activities, weekly schedule, bookings, members with email invitations and a mobile web app with the same design as Gym Class Pass Manager Pro.
